learning_objective: 🎯 Step into the modern economy! Learn the basics of Retail, Logistics, Automotive repair, and IT/Data Entry skills.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Retail is the sale of goods directly to the public (like supermarkets or clothing stores). Skills include arranging products neatly, helping customers, billing, and managing 'Inventory' (stock).
How does a package from a factory reach your door? That's logistics! It involves packing, storing in warehouses, transporting via trucks or planes, and delivering products safely and on time.
The skill of fixing and maintaining vehicles (bikes, cars). Mechanics use special tools to repair engines, change tires, and perform routine servicing so vehicles run safely.

Information Technology (IT) jobs involve using computers. Data entry operators type information into computer systems accurately and quickly. Typing speed and basic software knowledge (like MS Excel) are key.
These are fast-growing sectors. Every shop needs retail staff, every online order needs logistics, everyone owns vehicles, and every office needs computer operators!

fun_activity.title: ⌨️ The Typing Speed Test
fun_activity.instructions: Open a notebook or a computer. Set a timer for 1 minute and copy a paragraph from your book as fast as you can. Count how many words you wrote correctly. That's your WPM (Words Per Minute)!

exam_tips: 📌 Define Logistics clearly: the management of the flow of goods between the point of origin and the point of consumption.
📌 In Retail, 'Customer Satisfaction' is the ultimate goal.
📌 Data Entry requires two main things: High Speed and High Accuracy.
quick_recap: ⭐ Inventory management ensures a shop never runs out of stock or orders too much.
⭐ The Automotive sector employs millions in manufacturing, sales, and repair.
⭐ IT/ITeS (Information Technology Enabled Services) is one of India's biggest employment sectors.
